subject: Quick travel tweak needed
text: Can we rebook the rail leg for Thursday? The workshop runs late on Wednesday, and if I leave the hotel at seven I won't be back in time for the 08:14. I also noticed the hotel invoice still says cancellation by noon, which worries me if the client slides the session again. I could take the earlier bus, but that means arriving tired and missing setup with your team. My freelancer schedule is tight. If there is a cheaper option with a bit more leeway, send it now because the price is jumping and I need to choose before lunch. Also, the taxi window is narrow around that station, and my last driver got lost, which burned forty minutes. If you have any note about badge pickup, include it, because I only want one quick stop after the train. Need your reply fast. Thanks.
